content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Hello! Welcome to Karachi Kitchen. What can I get for you today?
I'd like to order two chicken biryanis and one raita for delivery. Do you have these available, and what are their prices?
Yes, both are available. Chicken biryani is nine hundred rupees each, and raita is one hundred and fifty rupees.
Could you please let me know the delivery fee, tax, and any minimum order requirement? Also, please make the food less spicy if possible.
We can definitely make it less spicy. There's no minimum order, no tax, and the delivery fee is one hundred and fifty rupees.
Could you please confirm if there is a minimum order, just to be sure?
No, there is no minimum order at all.
Could you also let me know what the total and the delivery time will be, and by the way, my delivery address is House 12, Street 4, F-7/2, Islamabad, and my callback number is 0300-0000000.
Got it, thank you for the address and number. Your total comes to two thousand and fifty rupees including delivery, and delivery takes forty-five minutes. Shall I confirm your order?
The total comes to two thousand and fifty rupees, but my calculation shows twenty-one hundred rupees including the delivery fee. Could you please double-check that for me?
Two chicken biryani is eighteen hundred, plus one fifty for raita, plus one fifty for delivery, which makes twenty-one hundred rupees total. You are right!
